sources.shortCitation: Hänsom Filmbilder, series 6, card 215 — Franz Grothe, Olly Gebauer, Liane Haid
sources.fullCitation: Film-collector's card, Hänsom Filmbilder, series 6, no. 215: “Franz Grothe — Olly Gebauer — Liane Haid.” Photograph credited “Ross” (Ross Verlag, Berlin); the card carries the Hänsom monogram. Germany, 1930s. Reproduced at Virtual History, person record for Franz Grothe. Accessed 16 August 2026.

sources.creator: Photograph credited to Ross Verlag, Berlin

media.title: Franz Grothe — detail of a Hänsom Filmbilder card, Ross photograph
media.description: Franz Grothe reading a score, in a detail of the film-collector's card that shows him with Olly Gebauer and Liane Haid.
media.altText: Black-and-white photograph of Franz Grothe in a suit, reading a sheet of music.
media.publicCaption: Franz Grothe reading a score. Detail of a Hänsom Filmbilder card, series 6, whose printed line reads “Franz Grothe — Olly Gebauer — Liane Haid” and whose photograph is credited to Ross.
media.publicCreditLine: Photograph credited “Ross”, Ross Verlag, Berlin; Hänsom Filmbilder, series 6, card 215.
media.rightsNote: Reuse rights are not cleared. The card was printed in Germany in the 1930s and names no photographer beyond the studio credit “Ross”, so no term can be computed from a photographer's death; read as an anonymous work, its German term of seventy years from publication was still running on the United States restoration date of 1 January 1996, and the URAA restored United States copyright. The displayed 350 × 395 px detail is cropped from a 1000 × 733 px reproduction of the whole card, for scholarly identification of a documented Kaper collaborator.
